text_block_list.text: —Let's sort out the situation.

The core of Believe's training regimen was 
'strengthening the duration of her 
full-speed dash.'

Hold on through a high pace and seize 
victory. I have come all this way to 
master that very form.

First, in the earliest stage, to suit an 
undeveloped body, we start with low-load, 
high-repetition training.

Through this, we built up her fundamental 
stamina and muscular strength.

"And once your body is built up, we'll 
transition to high-intensity, low-rep 
training next."

To build a physique suited for a sprinter, 
she spent her days focusing primarily on 
building fast-twitch muscle.

Building fast-twitch muscle is key because 
'anaerobic energy' is especially crucial.

"As the name suggests, this is anaerobic 
exercise— essentially, what you use when 
putting on a final spurt."

In sprints, which are pure contests of 
speed, this total anaerobic energy 
capacity is extremely crucial.

Furthermore, Believe's strategy relies on 
'Sprint Sustainability'... which means 
maintaining anaerobic exercise is the key.

"That is precisely why I meticulously 
conditioned my body up to this point, 
seeking to bolster my anaerobic energy. 
However—"

"To escape Durandal's late burst, we'll 
need a pace even faster than before. 
...Beyond the limit, and even further."

Until now, it's been "high intensity, low 
reps." In addition to that—
—Inflicting a hypoxic state.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. I am fine. I can... feel the 
effects, very much so.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Even though I'm not doing anything, on 
its own... my breathing is getting shallow 
and short.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Is this... the strategy Trainer thought 
through so carefully—)

What Believe is wearing is a specially 
developed 'High-Performance Hypoxia Mask.'

A mechanism built into the mask generates 
hypoxic air, forcing the wearer to breathe 
exclusively within low oxygen levels.

The oxygen concentration in the air 
Believe is breathing right now is under 
roughly 15%—

An altitude of about 3,000 meters is 
roughly equivalent to standing around the 
7th or 8th station of Mount Fuji.
choice_data_list:
Okay... Well then, let's get started just 
like that.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Understood. I'm counting on you.

"And keeping her in that state— I instruct 
Believe to do her usual 'high-intensity, 
low-repetition' training."

"In a hypoxic state, the body consumes 
anaerobic energy much faster and more 
intensely."

The goal is to enhance anaerobic energy 
capacity by repeating this multiple times.
......Logically speaking, that is correct.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant, huff*...!! Kh--

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Ugh, ack...?!

I instantly rushed over to her as she 
began to collapse, tearing the mask away 
from her face.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Gah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: *cough*, *hack*... *wheeze*, gah...!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*, *gasp*, *pant*, *pant*, 
*pant*...!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I-I'm... fine.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: *wheeze*... *pant*... *cough*...

Believe lets out a faint wheeze from her 
throat. ...Even sprint training, which she 
could normally breeze through, pushes her 
body this hard.

I feel it acutely... This, this truly is 
the "hypoxic training" that I ordered.

"It's a risky form of training. We must 
carefully deliberate the routine with 
doctors and specialists before moving 
forward—"

We have medical staff cooperating with us 
so we can respond immediately in case of 
an emergency. We're doing everything we 
can to ensure safety, but...

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
*sigh* *Inhhhaaale*... 
*Exhhhaaale*............

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...Excuse me. Please let me borrow the 
mask one more time."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Let's continue training.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Then, I'll keep the mask on as is.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
Beginning the shallow-water dash now. 
Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Please give the signal to start.

Clearly seeing Believe's masked figure 
steadily holding her stance, she lifted 
her trembling arms and raised her hands 
high—
Strike it.

...In a state of hypoxia, not only will 
you quickly become short of breath and 
struggle to keep up with breathing—

My lungs burn as if they're tearing apart, 
and my heart pounds hard enough to burst. 
A headache, dizziness, and nausea all 
strike at once.

With accumulated fatigue, muscles burn 
with pain, languor and weakness wash over 
the entire body, and then—

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (...It's so... hard to breathe...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (It hurts)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(It hurts, it hurts, it hurts, it hurts, 
it hurts, it hurts, it hurts, it hurts)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, ugh—
choice_data_list: Believe, stop! Hold on a second!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: I'm okay. I've calmed down now.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...No, I'm sorry. Even though we were... 
right in the middle of training.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I'm ready to resume now. The 
next routine is—
choice_data_list: ...No, let's wrap it up for today.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Is that so? Understood. I'll be 
counting on you again starting tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"Tomorrow for sure. I will see that 
hypoxic training through to the end."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...I look forward to working with you.

Even so, she says so straight without 
wavering.

Even if she threw herself into 
unimaginable agony. Even right after 
reaching her absolute limit and grinding 
to a halt.

Even so, Believe never compromised her 
dedication to hard work. She never lost 
her will to try her best.

...That conviction. The strength to hold 
true to it.

Unable to find an answer, I looked up and 
realized I had arrived at a deserted 
shoreline.

"We won't win like this." "Then how will 
we?" ...I had already given my answer.

I ended up teaching her. I ended up giving 
instructions. As a Trainer... I ended up 
doing my job.
choice_data_list:
(But... but was this really the right 
thing to do?)

text_block_list.text:
Even without closing my eyes, it comes 
back vividly. The sight of Believe 
collapsing after pushing herself past her 
limits is burned into my retinas, likely 
never to fade.

...Slowly drifting forward, stepping into 
the waves.

Eventually, the footing vanished, and with 
a heavy splash, she sank deep into the 
water.

Before long, it becomes hard to breathe. A 
self-deprecating smile appears at how 
quickly it happened.
choice_data_list:
(I mean, she must have been suffering far 
more.)

text_block_list.text:
"Her brain sounds the alarm. Her heart, 
too, chides her for her foolishness, 
saying that none of this means anything."

"Even so... for a little longer, just a 
while longer, I drifted aimlessly in the 
sea."

Even if it's just a fraction. ...I wanted 
to feel the pain she went through.

Emerging from the water. Alone, coughing 
violently.

The summer training camp has only just 
begun.
